sql: SELECT pm.match_id, pm.player_slot, pm.hero_id, m.radiant_win, m.start_time, m.duration, pm.gold_per_min AS gold_per_min, pm.xp_per_min AS xp_per_min, pm.kills AS kills, pm.deaths AS deaths, pm.assists AS assists, pm.last_hits AS last_hits, pm.denies AS denies, pm.hero_damage AS hero_damage, pm.tower_damage AS tower_damage, pm.hero_healing AS hero_healing, pm.net_worth AS net_worth, pm.obs_placed AS obs_placed, pm.sen_placed AS sen_placed, pm.camps_stacked AS camps_stacked, pm.rune_pickups AS rune_pickups, pm.stuns AS stuns, pm.teamfight_participation AS teamfight_participation, pm.level AS level, pm.lane_role AS lane_role, m.duration / 60.0 AS duration_min, (SELECT min((e->>'time')::int) FROM unnest(pm.purchase_log) e WHERE e->>'key' = 'black_king_bar') AS t_black_king_bar FROM player_matches pm JOIN matches m USING (match_id) JOIN match_patch mp USING (match_id) WHERE pm.hero_id = 44 AND mp.patch = '7.41' AND pm.purchase_log IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pm.match_id DESC LIMIT 500
